description: This line plot illustrates how the reliability score of three different models—labeled as “3-Model Ensemble” (blue), “2-Model Ensemble” (red), and “GPT-4” (yellow)—varies with increasing cost, ranging from 0 to 10 on the x-axis, which is labeled “Cost” and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” spans from 30 to 90 and also uses a linear scale. At a cost of 0, the reliability scores are approximately 85 for the 3-Model Ensemble, 87 for the 2-Model Ensemble, and 89 for GPT-4. As cost increases, all three lines show a downward trend. The GPT-4 line (yellow) declines most steeply, dropping from 89 at cost 0 to approximately 40 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble line (red) decreases from 87 to approximately 75, and the 3-Model Ensemble line (blue) decreases from 85 to approximately 76. The lines remain relatively close to each other across the cost range, with the GPT-4 line consistently below the ensemble lines until around cost 5, after which it falls below them.
